title: Stage 11 — Final Production Environment Certification
summary: Stage 11 closes the Stage 10 CONDITIONAL-GO environmental gaps using real infrastructure where available. No real external infrastructure is available in the sandbox (no DATABASE_URL, no GROQ_API_KEY, no object-storage sidecar, no browser), so each is classified BLOCKED. The isolated PGlite pgwire server (real Postgres wire protocol) was recreated and the actual production build was exercised against it: schema contract exact (23 tables/154 columns), typecheck + 40/40 tests + build PASS, auth/IDOR/security/CORS/concurrency/observability/migration-safety verified (LOCAL PASS). One HIGH defect was found and fixed this stage: non-atomic refresh-token rotation allowed concurrent replay (4/5 concurrent refreshes succeeded); fixed with an atomic UPDATE...RETURNING claim and re-verified (exactly 1 success per token).

baseline.reset_note: Sandbox was reset between Stage 10 and Stage 11 (local HEAD reverted to 25cbdf2); recovered from remote after confirming c0ea8f3 via git reset --hard. No work lost.

automated_evidence.clean_checkout: PASS (pnpm 10.34.5 pinned, frozen lockfile, no workspace mutation)

findings.issue: non-atomic refresh-token rotation allowed concurrent replay (TOCTOU)
findings.reproduction: 5 concurrent /auth/refresh with same token -> up to 4x 200
findings.fix: atomic UPDATE ... SET revoked_at ... WHERE revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at > now() RETURNING user_id
